data.name: Kartikay
data.gender_notes: Kartikay is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kartikay is the son of Lord Shiva and Parvati. He is the commander-in-chief of the army of the gods. The name Kartikay carries the meaning “Son of Lord Shiva” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kartikay usually hope their child will grow to embody son of lord shiva and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Kartikay belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Son of Lord Shiva.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kartikay total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, Kartikay represents the annihilation of ego and negative tendencies present within an individual. He symbolizes devotion, dedication, and the purifying power of Lord Shiva. Worshipping Lord Kartikay is believed to provide blessings for success, wealth, and happiness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Kartikay is a name derived from Lord Kartikeya, the god of war and son of Lord Shiva. It signifies bravery, leadership, and devotion to divine wisdom. The name is a reminder to embrace strength and courage while staying grounded in spiritual values.
